content.short: Encoins is a Cardano privacy protocol using encrypted redeeming values for native tokens and private minting.
content.description: Encoins is a Cardano privacy protocol built around native tokens with encrypted redeeming values. When users mint ENCOINS, the ADA value is converted to lovelace and encrypted so only the holder with the correct key can decrypt and redeem it later. This design gives users a way to protect transaction amounts while staying inside the Cardano ecosystem. Encoins focuses on private minting, encrypted value transfer, and stronger financial privacy for users who want more control over what is visible on-chain.
content.meta: Encoins adds privacy-focused token minting and encrypted value transfers to Cardano native assets. Explore Encoins on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
